entries.title: [Cohesian](https://cohesian.org) - Independent Education & Research
entries.subtitle: Founder, software engineer and author
paragraphs: Founded Cohesian to connect mathematics, computing, physics, and complex systems through writing, visual explanations, and developer tools. Personally created the tools and authored the books presented through the initiative.
bullets: [k-graph](https://github.com/cohesian-tools/k-graph): built a Node.js CLI and reusable validation library for Topic/Chapter/Lecture graphs, stable UUID references, directory/ZIP persistence, and HTML, PDF and frontend distribution with themes.

[Loci](https://github.com/cohesian-tools/loci): built a Python/Manim layer for narrated educational scenes, composable resources, graphs, 2D/3D planes, timelines and configuration, with companion CLI/plugin workflows.

[Tether](https://github.com/cohesian-tools/tether): built resource discovery, validation, resolution and materialization contracts with SHA-256 verification; separates exact copies from transformed publications.

[Josly](https://github.com/cohesian-tools/josly): built a standard-library JSON store and CLI with portable typed schemas, filters, projections and JSON Pointer writes; protects records with revisions, locks, atomic replacement and confined paths.

[Resumy](https://github.com/cohesian-tools/resumy): built an offline Python/ReportLab CV and letter generator with strict JSON validation, layered themes, configurable sections, typography and pagination.
[Optional](https://github.com/cohesian-tools/optional): developed generic optional and nullable Go types with JSON serialization.

Built Cohesian's static Home, Tools and Bookshelf site with Astro and Cloudflare, schema-validated catalogs and portable front presentation packages. Core defines the initiative's principles and identity.

entries.title: [Bookly Up - Introduction to System Architecture](https://cohesian.org/bookshelf/)
entries.subtitle: Author - 1st Edition: System Architecture
paragraphs: A language-independent guide to designing a booking system through relationships, responsibility boundaries, state models and time constraints.
bullets: Separated Site, Auth, Booking and Payment responsibilities; explained identity, signing/verification, localized users, resource ownership, listings and frozen booking terms.

Modeled booking lifecycles and overlapping Operation, Reserved and Historical state families. Distinguished trip intervals from state lifespans, State Time Constraints from calendar occupancy, and live payment holds from non-reserving proposals.

Derived availability from offered time minus live allocations and checked the whole requested interval for bookability. Separated Booking-owned cancellation/refund entitlement from Payment execution and verified financial outcomes.

The first edition establishes the architecture. Two further editions are planned: 2nd Edition - Modules Implementation, followed by 3rd Edition - Infrastructure, covering runtime topology, deployment and operations.
